t: File Diff Engine - public implementations survey
title: File Diff Engine - public implementations survey
definition: Compares file versions and highlights changes.
description:
This database surveys File Diff Engine as it exists in public practice: Compares file versions and highlights changes. The records below name real tools with real track records, explain the techniques they are built on, cite the standards they implement, and provide drills that build working skill. Nothing here is speculative - every implementation is a real project you can download, every technique is established practice.

The value of a survey like this is comparative: seeing seven real implementations side by side reveals what the capability truly requires and where each tool draws its boundaries. The technique records go deeper, explaining the machinery - the algorithms, protocols and disciplines - that make File Diff Engine work regardless of which tool you pick.

Use this database as a field guide. When a build calls for File Diff Engine, consult the spotlights to choose an implementation, check the standards to stay interoperable, and run the drills to build fluency. Each record's demo program runs with node - the capability is demonstrated end to end.

t: File Diff Engine failure-mode drill - practitioner discipline

definition: The failure-mode drill discipline for File Diff Engine: compares file versions and highlights changes..
description:
Good File Diff Engine practice is not talent - it is failure-mode drill. It turns File Diff Engine from an event into a repeatable capability.

Concretely: review the result with fresh eyes before calling it done; declare inputs, expected outputs, and acceptance checks before starting; run the smallest meaningful case first and verify it by hand This record exists because the difference between a tool and a capability is discipline. Run the demo, adopt the checklist, and File Diff Engine becomes something your builds can rely on.
